research_question: Can one pre-retrieval PM learn when a fixed Strategy resource is materially useful under quality-risk-cost constraints and transfer that decision across single-session and longitudinal observable states?

allowed_environment_differences: the cards returned by the same frozen retrieval function for different queries
forbidden_main_study_differences: domain identifier as a PM feature
domain-specific retriever Top-k threshold or prompt
external response judge or gold outcome used to tune the bank PM or thresholds

candidate_bank_structural_profile.interpretation: Top-down safe-technique reference only; not a clustering result, not a data-induced taxonomy, and not yet empirical proof of adequate ESConv or EvoEmo retrieval coverage.
candidate_bank_structural_profile.known_narrow_area: structured_planning has four compatible cards and no structured-burden card; V1.5 therefore limits RS to at most one support move per turn.

ESConv.memory_availability: MP MS and ME structurally unavailable
ESConv.tests: selective Strategy use and immediate response quality

EvoEmo_ES_MemEval_derived.memory_availability: longitudinal memory sources may be available
EvoEmo_ES_MemEval_derived.strategy_bank: the exact same frozen Strategy catalog and retrieval stack as ESConv
EvoEmo_ES_MemEval_derived.tests: joint source allocation; Strategy cards do not substitute for MP MS or ME content

required: support mode phase goal burden and risk opportunity coverage
positive material-benefit tie and harm contrasts
not_required: matching every external topic emotion or wording pattern
reproducing all eight raw ESConv strategy labels
using EvoEmo text outcomes or gold annotations to author cards

pre_freeze_gates.pass: Every surviving card is approved or corrected and no unresolved safety or boundary defect remains.
All declared modes phases and goals have eligible support moves and structured planning remains explicitly bounded to one move per turn.

On train/calibration states only, eligible-set and Top-k review reports relevant safe retrieval, wrong-family retrieval, no-eligible behavior and critical boundary failures without using response outcomes.
Frozen R0 versus RS clean pairs contain auditable material-benefit, tie and harm cases under the same response mechanism.

PM_target_rule: invalid or unexecuted treatment => unknown during training and R0 at inference
no sufficient probability of material response-quality benefit => R0
post_freeze_rule: External outcome-free diagnostics and final outcomes may be reported but may not be used to add cards or retune retrieval or PM. Any such change creates a new study identity.
separate_future_ablation: A domain-adapted Strategy Bank may be studied only as an explicitly named secondary resource-adaptation experiment and cannot support the main shared-PM cross-domain generalization claim.
